The Principality of Sabourg in 2024, a recognised sovereignty in the world
[vc_column_text]

Click on the title and learn more about Sabourg’s diplomatic missions

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text]Since its origins, the Principality of Sabourg has been an abbatial state composed of religious monks. The monks ruled Seborga, Sospel, and Ventimiglia from 1261 to 1729, when the principality was sold to the Savoy dynasty with the approval of the pope, who imposed as a condition for the transfer of the title the payment of debts owed to creditors, particularly those owed to the Republic of Genoa. This condition was not met, rendering the deed of sale ineffective. The territories of the Principality of Sabourg legitimately became a protectorate of the Crown of Savoy until 1946, and are still exercised today by the Italian Republic.

The Principality of Sabourg is divided into two priories:

  • the Priory of Seborga
  • the Priory of Saint Michel (formerly the Priory of the Chaplaincy of Saint Michel in Ventimiglia).

The capital is Seborga.

The territory of the Priory of Sabourg includes the current territory of the Municipality of Seborga, part of the Municipality of Ospedaletti, Perinaldo and Sanremo, as well as the island of Bergeggi in the Province of Savona.

The economic capital is La Grange, a smart city that will be build after the Official Agreement for a perpetual protectorat with the Italian Republic.

The Priory of Saint Michael consisted of La Grange, i.e., the territories that include part of the current territory of Ventimiglia, Airole, Olivetta San Michele, and Sospel (France). The area of the former territory was approximately 110 square kilometers.

The historical and religious continuity of the Principality of Sabourg is ensured today by His Most Reverend Highness Monsignor Giovanni Luca, Prince Abbot and Archbishop of Sabourg, elected 91st sovereign on September 29, 2019, and crowned by a high Orthodox prelate on December 28, 2019.

 

 

Official motto

“Sub umbra sedi”

The literary translation is ‘I sat in the shade’.
Psalm 91:1 of the Holy Scriptures states verbatim: ‘He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High rests in the shadow of the Almighty’.
In other words, those who are sheltered by the Lord are protected from the evil one. Further proof of the totally religious vocation of the principality.

Discovery Anthem of Sabourg

→ UN Recognition

His Most Reverend Highness, Mgr. Giovanni Luca, Prince-Abate Archbishop of Sabourg publicly subscribes to the Charter of the United Nations drawn up on 26 June 1945 in San Francisco (US) and confirms full compliance with its articles in order to request the UN Secretary General, Antonio Guterres, to accept the Principauté du Sabourg as a new member country.

 

→ Special Autonomy from the Republic of Italy

On 4 November 2020, His Most Reverend Highness, Monsignor Giovanni Luca, Prince-Abate Archbishop of Sabourg sent an official request to the President of the Council of Ministers, Head of the Government of the Republic of Italy, for the recognition of the Principality of Seborga, today a sovereign enclave without territorial possession, in order to define a bilateral agreement between States, aimed at obtaining special Autonomy of the lands that coincide with the Municipality of Seborga and part of the Municipality of Ventimiglia, as provided for by Article 5 of the Italian Constitution.
→ Read more

 

→ Establishment of the United Microstate Organisation

His Most Reverend Highness, Mgr. Giovanni Luca, Prince-Abate Archbishop of Sabourg invites the heads of government of the micro-states of the International Community to set up a new subject of international cooperation called the “Organisation of the United Micro-States” in order to encourage cooperation between states by unifying the voice of the micro-states for the development of a new common socio-economic order.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width=”stretch_row” css=”.vc_custom_1688747353645{margin-top: 50px !important;margin-bottom: -180px !important;padding-right: 50px !important;padding-left: 50px !important;}”][vc_column css=”.vc_custom_1759920367439{margin-bottom: 40px !important;}”][vc_column_text]

13th of december 2025

 

Prince-Abbot Feast Day 2025

Official message from His Most Reverend Highness the Prince-Abbot

Brothers and sisters, members of the clergy, Excellencies, high dignitaries of the Abbey State, officers of the Abbey Gendarmerie, members of the OESMC and all of you, dear subjects of Sabourg, we thank you for making the National Day an extraordinary event, worthy of a contemporary Sovereign.

The sixth anniversary of our coronation marks a more intense commitment for all members of the Council of Departments, our Minister Councillors. Taking the oath in San Martino Square, in the presence of the Patron Saint of Seborga, as our Secretary of State has donated a relic that preserves part of his holy body, makes your commitment and that of the highest dignitaries of the Principality of Sabourg sacred.

The year 2026 will define the affirmation of the monastic state for the general public, as the states of the international community, fascinated by your work, will accept the long-awaited official recognition.

Entrust your souls to the Holy Spirit, so that the eternal light may strengthen your spirits for this divine mission of charity in the service of the Most High.

Dedicate a few minutes of your day to reciting Psalm 91, which is our motto: Sub Unbra Sedi.

Fraternal blessings ☦️☦️☦️

Giovanni Luca Pietro II[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text]Read more[/vc_column_text][vc_single_image image=”2928″ img_size=”large”][vc_column_text]

Official Communiqué
of the meeting in the Vatican of His Most Reverend Highness Giovanni Luca Prince Abbot on 27 June 2024

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text]Prince-Abbot Archbishop of Sabourg Giovanni Luca travelled to Rome on Monday 24 June to accept the invitation of the President of the Brotherhood of St Michael Archangel and the Holy Spirit of the Borgo corridors.
At 6 p.m., Giovanni Luca participated, in his capacity as Prince-Abate Archbishop of Sabourg and Substitute Metropolitan Vicar General of the Orthodox Church in Italy, in the Solemn Mass for World Peace under the Protection of Our Lady of Debtors, at the Church of Santa Maria Annunziata in Borgo, on Vatican territory.
Together with the Prince of Sabourg, the members of the delegation that accompanied him on the visit were also seated in the seats reserved for the Authorities, next to the celebrant. This was composed of the Prime Minister of the Principality of Sabourg, His Excellency the Most Rev. Marc Vincent Vattier Exarch of the Gallican Church of France, Prof. Luigi Battistini Grand Commander of the Equestrian Order of St. Martin the Charitable, and the Director General of the Abatial Gendarmerie Land Division, Gen.
Giovanni Luca del Sabourg was very positive about the event held at the Vatican,
stating: ‘This is an important event for the Principality. It confirms the legitimacy of the Sabourg and of my ecclesiastical role, too often the subject of criticism from ill-informed people who are not inclined to accept the presence of our institution in its historical seat of Seborga.”
Furthermore, Prince Giovanni Luca expressed his special thanks to Dr. Gilberto Di Benedetto, for his work as custodian of the icon of Our Lady of the Debtors.

Seborga 2 July 2024
